english_description: Titanium. Higher melting temperature than most other metals, blocks all air pressure.
chinese_description: 钛,金属固体坚固的材料熔点很高能导电,会吸收中子

english_description: Exotic matter. Explodes with excess exposure to electrons. Has many other odd reactions.
chinese_description: 奇异物质,在电子的轰击下会发出彩虹色的光并产生压力

english_description: Reserved official element slot; never reuse this numeric ID.
chinese_description: 官方保留元素槽位；不得重新使用此数字 ID。
notes: Tombstone mapped to Meson disabler(); preserves save-ID continuity.

english_description: Sparks. Formed by explosions.
chinese_description: 火花,炸药爆炸产生

english_description: Hydrogen. Combusts with OXYG to make WATR. Undergoes fusion at high temperature and pressure.
chinese_description: 氢气,与氧气燃烧产生水,在高温高压下发生聚变

english_description: Soap. Creates bubbles, washes off deco color, and cures virus.
chinese_description: 肥皂,0.5P时产生肥皂泡可以洗去染色肥皂泡在-25℃/248.15k时会凝固

english_description: Black hole, sucks in particles using gravity. (Requires Newtonian gravity)
chinese_description: 黑洞,使用需开启牛顿万有引力,产生引力吸入物质并升温

english_description: White hole, pushes away other particles with gravity. (Requires Newtonian gravity)
chinese_description: 白洞,使用需开启牛顿万有引力,产生斥力排斥物质

english_description: Mercury. Volume changes with temperature, Conductive.
chinese_description: 水银,体积随温度变化,可以导电

english_description: Powered breakable clone.
chinese_description: 可控可破坏复制体,激活时和可破坏复制体相同

english_description: Gravity pump. Changes gravity to its temp when activated. (use HEAT/COOL)
chinese_description: 引力泵,激活时改变其万有引力为自身温度值

english_description: Clay dust. Produces paste when mixed with water.
chinese_description: 粘土砂,和水结合时产生浆糊(PSTE)

english_description: WireWorld wires, conducts based on a set of GOL-like rules.
chinese_description: WireWorld线,一种基于另一个名为WireWorld游戏的固体导电元素

english_description: Gravity bomb. Sticks to the first object it touches then produces a strong gravity push.
chinese_description: 引力炸弹,黏在接触的第一个物体上,产生强大的引力推力

english_description: Fighter. Tries to kill stickmen. You must first give it an element to kill him with.
chinese_description: 打手,电脑控制的小人,会通过喷东西来杀死火柴人

english_description: Force Emitter. Pushes or pulls objects based on its temperature. Use like ARAY.
chinese_description: F射线发射器,会沿着电流方向寻找物质并施加力(与ARAY的方向判定规则一样)

english_description: Repels or attracts particles based on its temperature.
chinese_description: 反射极,无需通电,和FRAY一样,根据温度来吸引或推开物质

english_description: Powered version of PIPE, use PSCN/NSCN to Activate/Deactivate.
chinese_description: 可控动力管,P型硅激活时运输,用N型硅则会停止运输,用超导线会反方向运输

english_description: Detector, creates a spark when something with its ctype is nearby.
chinese_description: 探测器,有相同的物质与之接触时产生电脉冲

english_description: Generates damaging pressure and breaks any elements it hits.
chinese_description: 重力炸弹,对碰到它的物质表面产生一个破坏性的压力

english_description: Temperature sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with a greater temperature.
chinese_description: 温度传感器,可以用HEAT/COOL来改变自身温度,当周围有温度比它高的物质时会发出电脉冲

english_description: Vibranium. Stores energy and releases it in violent explosions.
chinese_description: 振金,可以储存能量在猛烈的爆炸中释放出来

english_description: Broken vibranium.
chinese_description: 振金粉,粉末状的振金

english_description: Particle Ray Emitter. Creates a beam of particles set by its ctype, with a range set by tmp.
chinese_description: 物质射线发射器,发射一个由其Ctype设置的粒子束,其范围由Tmp设置

english_description: Piston, pushes particles. PSCN extends, NSCN retracts
chinese_description: 活塞,用PSCN激活时变长

english_description: Frame, can be used with pistons to push many particles.
chinese_description: 支架,用于增加活塞一次性推动物质的数量

english_description: Corrosion resistant metal, will reverse corrosion of iron. Excellent conductor.
chinese_description: 金,抗腐蚀(但通电时会受到酸的腐蚀),可以保护铁免受腐蚀

english_description: Tungsten. Brittle metal with a very high melting point.
chinese_description: 钨,脆性金属具有很高的熔点,但不耐压

english_description: Pressure sensor, creates a spark when the pressure is greater than its temperature.
chinese_description: 压力传感器,压力高于其温度时产生火花。

english_description: Protons. Transfer heat to materials, and remove sparks.
chinese_description: 质子,不能穿透绝缘体,虚空,钻石,振金以及墙会清除碰到电脉冲

english_description: Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Solid Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒块,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Gas Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒气,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Gravitons. Create Newtonian Gravity.
chinese_description: 引力子，会在周围产生额外的牛顿引力场。

english_description: Duplicator ray. Replicates a line of particles in front of it.
chinese_description: D射线发射器,会将沿电流方向对前方的所有粒子

english_description: Ceramic. Gets stronger under pressure.
chinese_description: 陶瓷,受压时熔点增加

english_description: Rapid heat conductor.
chinese_description: 导热体,导热速度比任何其他材料都快

english_description: Sawdust. Floats on water.
chinese_description: 锯末,轻粉末,可以漂浮在水面上

english_description: Polonium, highly radioactive. Decays into NEUT and heats up.
chinese_description: 钋,高放射性,衰变成NEUT并升温

english_description: Refrigerant. Heats up and liquefies under pressure.
chinese_description: 制冷剂,一种淡蓝色气体,在2P或更大压力下液化时加热,反之蒸发时冷却

english_description: Liquid refrigerant.
chinese_description: 液态制冷剂

english_description: Life sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with a life higher than its temperature.
chinese_description: 生命探测器,当其周围元素Life值高于传感器温度时,产生电流

english_description: Linear detector. Scans in 8 directions for particles with its ctype and creates a spark on the opposite side.
chinese_description: 线性探测器,从8个方向检测粒子,并在相反方向激发导体

english_description: Powdered Silicon. A key ingredient in producing multiple materials.
chinese_description: 硅粉,一种非常闪亮的粉末,像黄金一样导电

english_description: Platinum. Catalyzes certain reactions.
chinese_description: 铂,可以催化某些反应

english_description: Velocity sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with velocity higher than its temperature.
chinese_description: 速度探测器,当速度高于传感器温度的粒子在附近时,会生成电脉冲

english_description: Solid, melts into various elements.
chinese_description: 岩石,坚固的材料,CNCT可以堆叠在它上面

english_description: Lithium. Reactive element that explodes on contact with water.
chinese_description: 锂,与水接触会发生爆炸,可用于制造电池

english_description: Resist. Solidifies on contact with photons, is destroyed by electrons and spark.
chinese_description: 光刻胶,遇PHOT固化,会被ELEC和SPRK破坏

english_description: Solidified resist. Blocks pressure and insulates electricity. Liquefies on contact with neutrons.
chinese_description: 固化光刻胶,绝缘,遇NEUT液化,且会反射PHOT

english_description: Caustic base. Corrodes conductive solids and neutralizes acids.
chinese_description: 强腐蚀性碱液，会腐蚀导电固体并中和酸。

english_description: Seeds. Put on sand and add water to grow a tree.
chinese_description: 种子,放在沙子上时浇水会生长树木
